source_instruction: i am looking for a 10 foot high speed coaxial cable.
query: Man, the stray calico that’s been hanging around my back porch finally let me pet her yesterday, she had the softest little orange patch on her forehead and kept kneading my hoodie sleeve like she was making biscuits. I stopped by the corner bakery on the walk over too, they had those honey oat loaves I like still warm from the oven, and the kid at the register gave me an extra free chocolate chip cookie because I mentioned the cat. I’ve been binging that old 90s space documentary series lately too, the one where they go through all the early Apollo mission mishaps, I stayed up two nights in a row binging half the season even though I had to get up early for work. I heard coaxial cable that’s high speed works really well for hooking up the stuff in this satellite television section, and I’ve also heard the 10ft length fits the run from my wall outlet to my receiver perfectly, and all the options people rave about around that spec come in under 40 bucks.
